**SALT LAKE CITY — November 17, 2026** — ReposiTrak, Inc. (NYSE: TRAK), the leader in retail supply chain, merchandising, compliance and traceability solutions, today announced that a dairy supplier has selected Touchless Retail™ to provide weekday Light Touch merchandising services, helping maintain product availability, improve shelf conditions and support stronger in-store execution.


Dairy products require consistent attention at the shelf, where high product turnover, limited shelf space and frequent replenishment needs can quickly create out-of-stock conditions. The supplier will use Touchless Retail’s APEX Merchandising team to provide supplemental merchandising support during the week, helping ensure products are properly stocked, organized and available for purchase.


Touchless Retail combines fixed-cost merchandising, typically 50% less expensive than traditional hourly services, with an elite team of the industry’s best merchandising professionals. Its APEX Merchandising team consists of only the top 10% of merchandisers, selected for their performance and reliability, delivering a 99%+ on-time and show-up rate with less than 0.5% rework.


“Dairy is a category where shelf conditions can change quickly, and even short periods of poor availability can mean lost sales,” said Randy Fields, chairman and CEO of ReposiTrak. “This supplier is taking a more effective approach to weekday merchandising by putting the industry’s best professionals in stores at approximately half the traditional cost. It’s a compelling combination of better execution and better economics.”


The supplier’s Light Touch program will focus on maintaining shelf conditions between regular deliveries and merchandising visits. Activities include replenishing available product, organizing and facing merchandise, checking product placement and identifying shelf conditions that may require attention.


Unlike traditional hourly merchandising programs, Touchless Retail uses a predictable fixed-cost structure, allowing suppliers to expand in-store coverage while maintaining greater control over merchandising expenses. Services are available independently of ReposiTrak’s Scan-based Trading solution, enabling suppliers to benefit from professional merchandising without changing their existing trading arrangements.


“Suppliers are recognizing that they don’t need to accept inconsistent execution or escalating labor costs as the price of maintaining their shelves,” Fields added. “With Touchless Retail, they can put more attention where it’s needed, improve product availability and do it at a much lower cost.”


The addition of weekday Light Touch merchandising reflects continued adoption of Touchless Retail among suppliers seeking more flexible, reliable and cost-effective alternatives to conventional merchandising programs.


**About ReposiTrak** ReposiTrak, Inc. (NYSE: TRAK) is an AI-powered, integrated platform that connects retailers, wholesalers, suppliers, and food manufacturers through a suite of applications designed to reduce risk, support regulatory compliance, strengthen operational controls, and protect brand integrity. The ReposiTrak platform serves as a shared system of record across its solution areas, maintaining and synchronizing complex supplier and customer data to enable secure, accurate, and scalable information exchange.


ReposiTrak’s solutions are organized into three core product families: traceability, compliance and risk management, and supply chain solutions. Through its scalable, cloud-based platform and U.S.-based team of experts, the Company helps organizations streamline operations, improve data transparency, and meet evolving regulatory requirements across the food supply chain.


For more information, visit[www.repositrak.com](https://www.repositrak.com/) .


**About SPAR Group** SPAR Group is a merchandising and retail services company providing in-store merchandising, product resets, remodels, and other retail execution services. Its field teams support retailers and consumer brands in improving product presentation, implementing merchandising programs, and maintaining consistent execution across retail locations.


For more information, visit[www.sparinc.com](http://www.sparinc.com/) .
